The research CLI's menu, JSON configuration compatibility and porkchop workflow
are adapted from Controller92/Simple-Lambert-Solver, branch Flyby-Solver,
commit 6c58c779a91c8a9a32a514708089583c2f9d7e23 (2025).
Original MIT license: Simple-Lambert-Solver-LICENSE.txt.

The numerical grid runner, SI/native adapter and provenance/cache layer use this
repository's validated custom solver. No PyKEP, poliastro, flyby equations or
unvalidated trajectory-search implementation was copied into the runtime.
